blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: het verschil kennen tussen needn't have done en didn't need to do
waarschijnlijkheid nuanceren met may well, might just, could easily
plannen in het verleden uitdrukken met was to en was supposed to
would en will gebruiken voor gewoontes en eigenschappen

blocks.text: 1. needn't have of didn't need to?

head: Vorm
Voorbeeld
Betekenis
rows: You needn't have brought a present.
je hebt het gedaan, maar het was niet nodig
I didn't need to buy a ticket. (so I didn't)
het was niet nodig (en meestal niet gedaan)

blocks.title: Dat had je niet hoeven doen
blocks.text: Dat had je niet hoeven doen (je deed het wel) = You needn't have done that. Ik hoefde niet te betalen = I didn't need to pay / I didn't have to pay.

head: Vorm
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: Ze heeft heel goed mogelijk gelijk.
We might just catch the train if we run.
We halen de trein misschien nog net.
It could easily take a week.
Het kan best een week duren.
may as well / might as well
We might as well go home.
We kunnen net zo goed naar huis gaan.

blocks.text: 3. Plannen en verwachtingen in het verleden

head: Vorm
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: The meeting was to have taken place today.
De vergadering zou vandaag plaatsvinden (maar niet).
You were supposed to call me!
This film is meant to be good.
Deze film schijnt goed te zijn.

blocks.text: would beschrijft herhaalde handelingen in het verleden (pdf B2 · 1). will kan een typische eigenschap of gewoonte in het heden uitdrukken: She'll sit there for hours, just reading. Met klemtoon op will of would klinkt het geïrriteerd: He will leave the door open! (Hij laat ook altijd de deur open!)

can heeft geen infinitief of voltooide vorm. Gebruik dan be able to: I'd like to be able to speak Chinese. I haven't been able to sleep. Voor één gelukte prestatie in het verleden gebruik je was able to / managed to, niet could: After hours, we managed to open the door.

blocks.title: Het lukte ons = we managed to
blocks.text: Het lukte me om de trein te halen = I managed to catch the train of I was able to catch the train. I could catch the train klinkt alsof je het in het algemeen kon.

rows: I will can help you tomorrow.
I will be able to help you tomorrow.
After hours, we could open the door.
After hours, we managed to open the door.
You were suppose to call me.
You were supposed to call me.
I haven't been able to sleep.

blocks.text: Vul de juiste vorm in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: You ______ have cooked. I'd already eaten.
items.full: You needn't have cooked. I'd already eaten.

items.q: I didn't ______ to wait. The bus came at once.
items.full: I didn't need to wait. The bus came at once.

items.q: She may ______ be right about that.
items.full: She may well be right about that.

items.q: There's nothing on TV. We might as ______ go to bed.
items.full: There's nothing on TV. We might as well go to bed.

items.q: You were ______ to be here at nine!
items.full: You were supposed to be here at nine!

items.q: This restaurant is ______ to be excellent.
items.full: This restaurant is meant to be excellent.

items.q: I haven't ______ able to contact him.
items.full: I haven't been able to contact him.

items.q: After three attempts, she ______ to pass her driving test.
items.full: After three attempts, she managed to pass her driving test.

items.q: The wedding was ______ have taken place in June.
items.full: The wedding was to have taken place in June.

items.q: He's ______ to find out sooner or later.
items.full: He's bound to find out sooner or later.

items.q: Dat had je niet hoeven doen.

items.a: You were supposed to call me!

items.q: Het lukte me om de trein te halen.
items.a: I managed to catch the train.

items.q: We kunnen net zo goed naar huis gaan.
items.a: We might as well go home.
